svg.title: Swir // Pixel Tank Patrol LIVE
svg.desc: Original pixel tank automatically aims and fires at every active GitHub calendar day, once per loop. Hit cells vanish, the score credits their actual contributions, and the grid returns. 2025-09-20 to 2026-09-19; 8561 contributions in 26 active days. Continuous 48.8 second animation; snapshot 2026-09-19 10:37 UTC. This is a visualization, not a playable game. The LIVE view keeps its core motion; reduced-motion preferences hide decorative flashes. A separate static view is available.
